@page "/spreadsheet/conditional-formatting"

@using Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet
@using System;
@using System.IO;

@*Hidden:Lines*@
@inherits SampleBaseComponent;
@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
@*End:Hidden*@


<SampleDescription>
    <p>This sample demonstrates conditional formatting for inventory data. Explore highlight cell rules, data bars, color scales, and icon sets.</p>
</SampleDescription>

<ActionDescription>
    <p>This sample demonstrates how to apply conditional formatting to an inventory dataset in the Blazor Spreadsheet. Use highlight cell rules, top and bottom rules, data bars, color scales, and icon sets to visualize data patterns. To enable conditional formatting, set the <a href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_AllowConditionalFormat" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Navigate to the AllowConditionalFormatting property documentation">AllowConditionalFormat</a> property to <strong>true</strong>. This allows users to highlight data patterns with rules, data bars, color scales, and icon sets.</p>

    <p><strong>Key Features</strong></p>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Highlight cells rules</strong> - Format cells using greater than, less than, between, equal to, contains text, date occurring, and duplicate value conditions.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Top and bottom rules</strong> - Highlight Top 10 Items, Top 10%, Bottom 10 Items, Bottom 10%, Above Average, and Below Average values.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Data bars</strong> - Display bars inside cells to compare numeric values visually.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Color scales</strong> - Apply gradient colors to represent value distribution across a range.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Icon sets</strong> - Use arrows, shapes, and indicators to represent value trends.
        </li>
    </ul>

    <p>
        Apply rules from the <strong>Conditional Formatting</strong> dropdown in the ribbon or use <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_ConditionalFormatAsync" aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet ConditionalFormatAsync documentation">ConditionalFormatAsync</a> and <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_ClearConditionalFormatsAsync_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet ClearConditionalFormatsAsync documentation">ClearConditionalFormatsAsync</a> to add formatting rules programmatically and remove them from a selected range or the active worksheet.
    </p>

    <p><strong>Documentation Links</strong></p>
    <ul>
        <li><a href="https://help.syncfusion.com/document-processing/excel/spreadsheet/blazor/formatting#conditional-formatting" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet conditional formatting documentation">Conditional Formatting</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_AllowConditionalFormat" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Navigate to the AllowConditionalFormatting property documentation">API Reference</a></li>
    </ul>

    <p><strong>More Resources</strong></p>
    <ul>
        <li><a href="https://github.com/SyncfusionExamples/blazor-spreadsheet-examples" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View the sample in GitHub">View Sample in GitHub</a></li>
    </ul>
    <p>Looking for the full Blazor Spreadsheet Editor component overview, features, pricing, and documentation? Visit the <a rel="noopener" target='_blank' href='https://www.syncfusion.com/spreadsheet-editor-sdk/blazor-spreadsheet-editor' aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet Editor FT page">Blazor Spreadsheet Editor component</a> page.</p>
</ActionDescription>


<div class="col-lg-12 control-section">
    <div class="content-wrapper">
        <div class="row">
            <div>
                <SfSpreadsheet DataSource="DataSourceBytes" @ref=_spreadsheetInstance>
                    <SpreadsheetRibbon></SpreadsheetRibbon>
                </SfSpreadsheet>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@*Hidden:Lines*@
<style>
    .e-spreadsheet-protection-dialog label,
    .e-spreadsheet-unprotect-dialog label,
    .e-unprotectworkbook-dlg label,
    .e-spreadsheet-name-manager-content label {
        font-weight: normal !important;
        margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .e-protectworkbook-dlg label {
        font-weight: normal !important;
    }
</style>
@*End:Hidden*@

@code {

    public byte[] DataSourceBytes { get; set; }
    public SfSpreadsheet _spreadsheetInstance { get; set; }

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        @*Server:Block*@
#if !(WASM)
        //Sets the excel file path for initial loading.
        string filePath = "wwwroot/data/spreadsheet/conditionalformatting.xlsx";
        DataSourceBytes = File.ReadAllBytes(filePath);
#endif
        @*End:Server*@

        @*WebAssembly:Block*@
#if (WASM)
    //Sets the excel file path for initial loading.
    string filePath = "";
    DataSourceBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(filePath);
#endif
        @*End:WebAssembly*@
    }

    @*Hidden:Lines*@
    @*WebAssembly:Block*@
#if (WASM)
    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            _spreadsheetInstance.CustomFonts = CustomFonts;
        }
    }

    public List<string> CustomFonts = new List<string>
    {
        "fonts/Arial.TTF",
        "fonts/Calibri.TTF",
        "fonts/Courier New.TTF",
        "fonts/Georgia.TTF",
        "fonts/Algerian.TTF",
        "fonts/Cambria.TTF",
        "fonts/Cambria Math.TTF",
        "fonts/Candara.TTF",
        "fonts/Impact.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe Print.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe UI.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe Script.TTF",
        "fonts/Symbol.TTF",
        "fonts/Times New Roman.TTF",
        "fonts/Verdana.TTF",
        "fonts/Wingdings.TTF"
    };
#endif
    @*End:WebAssembly*@
    @*End:Hidden*@
}
